name: Good first issue
about: A small task that's safe for new contributors
labels: good first issue
---

### Summary

Describe a simple, self-contained task (typo fix, small doc improvement, tiny test) that a new contributor can complete.

### Steps to reproduce / task

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a branch named `fix/<short-description>`
3. Make a small change and open a pull request

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Change is small and well-described
- [ ] Tests (if any) still pass

Thanks — maintainers will review and merge small fix PRs quickly.
